title: Direct sums and finite cohomological dimension
statement:
Let $n\ge1$, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a
quasi-compact and
quasi-separated morphism with $\kuncd(f)<\infty$.

1. **(1)** $Rf_*:D(X_{\Et},\kunZn)\to D(Y_{\Et},\kunZn)$ commutes with
set-indexed direct sums.
1. **(2)** If $X$ is a qcqs scheme with $\kuncd(X)<\infty$, then
$\RGamma(X_{\Et},-):D(X_{\Et},\kunZn)\to D(\kunZn)$ commutes with
set-indexed direct sums.

proof.text: Since n >= 1, ZMod n and its ULift are finite rings. Every sheaf of modules over this ring has torsion underlying abelian sheaf, by Scheme.isTorsionModuleSheaf_iff_isTorsion and the finite-coefficient torsion instance. Apply sInf_lt_iff to the numerical dimension to obtain a natural bound d. These steps are the finite-coefficient specialization of the definition of torsion cohomological dimension.

For f, use nonempty_higherDirectImage_forget_iso to transfer the torsion abelian bound to each module higher direct image. Faithfulness of sheafCompose reflects a zero identity. The source library homologyRightDerivedLowerStarSingleIsoHigherDirectImage identifies this with unbounded derived direct image of a degree-zero sheaf. Integer degrees above d are natural degrees. This proves HasFiniteCohomologicalDimensionMorphism (ULift (ZMod n)) f.

For X, apply nonempty_etaleModuleCohomology_forgetIso to transfer the torsion abelian cohomology bound to module cohomology of each sheaf. An isomorphism of underlying abelian groups transports subsingletonness, and a subsingleton module is a zero object. Again every integer degree above d is natural. This proves HasFiniteCohomologicalDimension (ULift (ZMod n)) X.

Apply the already proved source-library theorems Etale.preservesCoproducts_rightDerivedLowerStar and Etale.preservesCoproducts_rightDerivedGlobalSections in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.Kunneth.Coproducts. They are the coefficient-specific realization of this same blueprint lemma, already proved by the acyclic-complex argument of Stacks 0F11. The bounds in the preceding steps discharge their hypotheses. This is an application of existing proved declarations, not a new open statement or an invocation of this theorem itself.

Extend preservation from Type (u+1) to every indexing universe using the proved private CategoryTheory.preservesCoproducts_of_small from WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.CompactTestsRightAdjointCoproducts, accessed through import all. For an existing coproduct B the nonzero summands inject into End(B) through their pairwise distinct projector idempotents, so local (u+1)-smallness makes their support (u+1)-small. Shrink the support and remove zero summands. The derived functors preserve zero morphisms and zero objects, so their images have the same coproduct universal property. This argument includes empty support. Only this general elementary universe argument is used, with no compact generators or compactness assumption.
